summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives in Qatar with a commanding 98-point lead over Max Verstappen, but Mercedes' advantage extends beyond the driver's seat as George Russell shadows the world champion atop the practice times. The tire allocation—capped at 27 laps per set—will force teams into sharp strategic calculations on a track where fuel consumption and degradation loom large. With only Abu Dhabi remaining after Qatar, Antonelli can effectively secure the drivers' championship this weekend while Mercedes inches closer to wrapping up the constructors' title against Ferrari's 149-point deficit.
